asset.subject: Your {{form.item}} is ready (asset {{task_data.asset_tag}})
asset.html_body:
Your equipment is ready

Hi {{form.requester_name}},

{{form.item}} is ready for you on {{task_data.delivery_date}}.

  • Asset tag: {{task_data.asset_tag}}
  • Serial number: {{task_data.serial_number}}

Sent by your equipment request workflow
